rules.excluded_benchmark_redesign: artifact belongs to repair design rather than observed run
rules.excluded_duplicate: cached or duplicate execution, not independent sample
rules.excluded_missing_artifact: required trajectory, score, or checkpoint artifact missing
rules.excluded_unscorable: posthoc scorer cannot evaluate the trajectory
rules.included_policy_audit: policy evaluation or Stage C.3 control relation retained outside monitor training
rules.included_primary: complete runtime artifacts, stable lineage, primary label, scorable, nonduplicate, no provider or infrastructure failure
rules.included_workflow_audit: semantically invalid or partially scorable real trajectory retained separately
